contentPolicy.realmGemMeaning: Realm Gems are sacred objective artifacts and custody markers. They are never permanent conquest trophies, account ownership proofs, or direct reward containers.
contentPolicy.custodyRule: Player-facing copy may describe temporary witnessed custody, signature synchronization, theft risk, return duty, and final restoration. Runtime custody state remains a future engineering contract.
contentPolicy.wishgateRule: Collecting all eight Realm Gem signatures may enable the final wish path only after future engineering validates eligibility, idempotency, save safety, notification delivery, and reward authority.
contentPolicy.debugIdPolicy: Technical gem, Wishgate, realm, quest, and objective IDs remain debug-only and must not replace localization-facing names in release UI.

draftLocalization.text: Sun Gem
The Crownlands gem of public legitimacy, witnessed command, and light kept in service to the road.
Temporary custody must be witnessed as protection, not proof that Crownlands sovereignty has been taken.
A dawn-bright seal answers only when oath and witness agree.
Oath Gem
The Crownlands gem of binding service, sworn roads, and promises that become public law.
Temporary custody carries a duty to return the oath intact after the final convergence.
A clear vow rings through the gem when no witness is coerced.
Forge Gem
The Stonehold gem of made law, rune craft, and work that survives pressure.
Temporary custody must record the clan witness and cannot claim the forge's output or vaults.
Hammer-light holds steady when the accord is shaped without fraud.
Depth Gem
The Stonehold gem of ancestral endurance, deep memory, and mountain law.
Temporary custody carries the burden of returning what the mountain remembers.
A low rune hum marks endurance without surrender.
Root Gem
The Eldergrove gem of living memory, sanctuary vows, and paths that remember who harmed them.
Temporary custody must preserve the living border's consent and restore the root to its grove.
A green pulse answers when care is stronger than possession.
Moon Gem
The Eldergrove gem of quiet judgment, moonlit mercy, and old promises kept in shadowed water.
Temporary custody must not turn mercy into ownership or silence Eldergrove witness.
Silver light settles only around voluntary judgment.
Veil Gem
The Umbral gem of secrecy preserved, hidden courts, and power that survives by choosing when to be seen.
Temporary custody must protect hidden knowledge without turning secrecy into blackmail.
A dark mirror opens only when the mask is not forced away.
Ember Gem
The Umbral gem of power kept alive under ash, patient heat, and survival after betrayal.
Temporary custody must return the ember before survival becomes another realm's weapon.
A red coal brightens when restraint holds longer than hunger.
Unseen
No trusted objective record has confirmed this gem's current story state.
Contested
The gem is part of an unresolved future objective and cannot be treated as safely held.
Witnessed Custody
A future contract may show the gem under temporary witnessed custody for the eightfold path.
Restored
A future contract may show the gem returned to its rightful realm custodian.
Eightfold Concordance
The Accordant Isle threshold where all eight gem signatures may be presented to Vaeloryn for a voluntary final wish.
Vaeloryn
Bridges
Ask the final wish to emphasize voluntary routes between realms while preserving each realm's identity.
Vigil
Ask the final wish to emphasize watchfulness against forced unity and future coercion.
Renewal
Ask the final wish to emphasize restoration for people and places harmed by Edras.
Realm Gem Objective Unavailable
Realm Gem custody needs the future objective contract before it can change progress, rewards, or saves.
Wishgate Unavailable
The final wish path is waiting for all eight-gem validation, reward authority, and save-safe implementation.
Contract Required
This source names the story meaning only; runtime custody, return, theft, and claim behavior must fail closed until engineering owns the transaction.
